title: The Title Chosen Last
fact_notes: 登場人物、具体的な出来事・観察・記録は架空の教材例。実在の調査結果ではない。参考リンクは制作台帳であり外部の実証資料ではない。

sentences.en: In an English writing class, students were asked to read a short story without its title.
sentences.ja: 英語の作文授業で、生徒は題名のない短編小説を読むよう求められた。

sentences.en: The story described a girl who carried a heavy bag to a railway station every morning.
sentences.ja: 物語には毎朝重いかばんを駅まで運ぶ少女が描かれていた。

sentences.en: She never boarded a train, but she always waited until a particular train had departed.
sentences.ja: 列車には乗らなかったが、特定の列車が出発するまで必ず待っていた。

sentences.en: The reason for her unusual routine was not explained until near the end of the story.
sentences.ja: その変わった日課の理由は物語の終盤まで説明されなかった。

sentences.en: The students suggested several possible titles immediately after reading the opening paragraphs.
sentences.ja: 生徒は冒頭の段落を読んだ直後に、題名の候補をいくつか提案した。

sentences.en: Some imagined that the girl was preparing to leave home, while others expected a story about a secret journey.
sentences.ja: 家を出ようとしていると想像する人もいれば、秘密の旅の物語だと予想する人もいた。

sentences.en: Their teacher asked them to record the details that supported each prediction.
sentences.ja: 教師は各予想を支える細部を記録するよう求めた。

sentences.en: She also encouraged them to remain open to information that might change their understanding.
sentences.ja: 理解を変えるかもしれない情報を受け入れるよう促した。

sentences.en: In the final scene, the girl opened her bag and revealed a collection of old drawings.
sentences.ja: 最後の場面で少女はかばんを開け、古い絵の集まりを明らかにした。

sentences.en: She had been showing the drawings to her grandfather, who worked at the station every morning.
sentences.ja: 彼女は毎朝駅で働く祖父に絵を見せていたのだった。

sentences.en: They used the departure of the train as a familiar signal that their short meeting was over.
sentences.ja: 列車の出発を短い面会の終わりを知らせる慣れた合図として使っていた。

sentences.en: The students now understood why the girl had never needed to buy a ticket.
sentences.ja: 生徒たちは少女が切符を買う必要がなかった理由を理解した。

sentences.en: After finishing the story, each student selected a title and explained the choice in a few sentences.
sentences.ja: 物語を読み終え、各生徒は題名を選び、その理由を数文で説明した。

sentences.en: One group focused on the station, whereas another group emphasized the relationship between the two characters.
sentences.ja: 一方のグループは駅に注目したが、別のグループは二人の人物の関係を重視した。

sentences.en: Their teacher did not insist that only one title could be appropriate.
sentences.ja: 教師は適切な題名が一つだけだとは主張しなかった。

sentences.en: Instead, she asked whether the proposed title reflected details that were actually present in the text.
sentences.ja: 代わりに提案された題名が実際に本文にある細部を反映しているか尋ねた。

sentences.en: The students discovered that a title can guide attention before the first sentence is read.
sentences.ja: 題名は最初の文を読む前から注意を導き得ると気づいた。

sentences.en: It may create expectations that later events confirm, complicate, or completely overturn.
sentences.ja: 題名は後の出来事が裏付けたり複雑にしたり覆したりする期待を生む場合がある。

sentences.en: A thoughtful title can express an interpretation without revealing every important event in advance.
sentences.ja: よく考えられた題名は重要な出来事をすべて事前に明かすことなく解釈を表せる。

sentences.en: Choosing a title therefore became another way of reading the story closely.
sentences.ja: 題名を選ぶことは、物語を精読する別の方法になった。

vocabulary.definition: formed an idea in the mind
travel from one place to another
gave support or motivation to act
act of going away from a place
way people or things are connected

questions.prompt: What was missing from the story when students began reading?
questions.explanation_ja: 題名がない状態で読んだ。

questions.prompt: What did the girl do every morning?
options: Carried a heavy bag to a railway station.
questions.explanation_ja: 重いかばんを駅に運んだ。

options: That the girl was preparing to leave home.
That the train had been canceled.
That the station had closed forever.
That the girl owned a railway company.
questions.explanation_ja: 家を出ようとしていると予想した。

questions.prompt: Why did the teacher encourage students to record supporting details?
options: To help them ignore the ending.
To connect their predictions with evidence in the text.
To prohibit changes to their ideas.
questions.explanation_ja: 予想を本文中の根拠と結びつけるため。

questions.prompt: What was actually inside the bag?
What did the departure of the train signal?
options: The end of the girl's meeting with her grandfather.
questions.explanation_ja: 祖父との面会の終わりの合図。

questions.prompt: Why could different titles be acceptable?
options: The teacher had not read the story.
The title did not need any connection to the story.
The students had read completely different stories.
Different interpretations could be supported by the text.
questions.explanation_ja: 本文の根拠に支えられた異なる解釈が可能だから。

questions.prompt: What did the teacher ask about the proposed title?
options: Whether it was the longest title.
Whether it reflected details in the story.
Whether it was copied from a textbook.
questions.explanation_ja: 本文にある細部を反映しているか。

questions.prompt: What does overturn mean in this context?
options: Reverse or reject an earlier expectation.

questions.prompt: What is the main point of the passage?
options: Choosing a title can deepen evidence-based reading and interpretation.
An effective title must reveal the ending.
A story can have only one reasonable interpretation.
questions.explanation_ja: 題名の選択によって根拠に基づく精読を深められる。

grammar.focus: until a particular train had departed
grammar.explanation_ja: untilはある時点までの継続を示す。
whileは二つの見方を対比する。

grammar.focus: whether the proposed title reflected details
grammar.explanation_ja: whether節は尋ねた内容を示す間接疑問。
without＋動名詞は〜することなく。

discourse.role_ja: 根拠の記録に加え考えの修正も促す。
唯一の題名を求めるのではなく根拠を問う。
題名選びが精読になるという結論。

paraphrases.source: She never boarded a train, but she always waited until a particular train had departed.
paraphrases.rewrite: She did not get on a train but remained at the station until a certain train left.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 特定の列車の出発まで駅で待った。

paraphrases.source: Some imagined that the girl was preparing to leave home, while others expected a story about a secret journey.
paraphrases.rewrite: Some readers predicted that she would leave home, but others imagined a secret trip.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 生徒の異なる予想を対比。

paraphrases.source: Instead, she asked whether the proposed title reflected details that were actually present in the text.
paraphrases.rewrite: She asked if the suggested heading was supported by information found in the story.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 本文の情報に支えられた題名か尋ねた。

paraphrases.source: A thoughtful title can express an interpretation without revealing every important event in advance.
paraphrases.rewrite: A carefully selected title may convey a reading of the story while keeping some events a surprise.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 題名は展開をすべて明かさず解釈を表せる。
